key_insight: Simulation-driven hydrofoil optimization improved efficiency, with adjoint optimization delivering a reported 15% gain over the conventional design.
engineering_relevance: CFD-based optimization offers a systematic alternative to intuition-led hydrofoil tuning for foil windsurfing.
method: Capture baseline geometry using structured light scanning and explore five aircraft-wing-inspired designs.
Train a machine learning surrogate on design-of-experiments simulation data for multi-objective optimization.
Apply adjoint optimization to refine designs with greater geometric freedom.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports simulation-based improvements from both optimization approaches, including a 15% efficiency increase from adjoint optimization.
watch_item: Benefits depend on operating conditions; the surrogate explored restricted design parameters, and the abstract reports no physical validation.
paper_title: Improving Hydrofoil Efficiency Through Simulation-Driven Design Optimization
